Mutant 2 (>= → <=) killed: is_adult(25) now returns FALSE, fails first test. Mutant 1 (>= → >) survives: is_adult(25) still returns TRUE is_adult(10) still returns FALSE — boundary value 18 never tested, test suite tell >= >. killed 1 mutant 2, mutation score 50%. survivor tells us exactly fix — add test boundary: test added score reaches 100%.
